name: Apostle of Judgment

skills.description: Deals 100% Spell Power as Fire DMG to 1 enemy within melee range.

scaling.text: Fire DMG equal to 100% of Spell Power

skills.name: Mirage Dance
skills.description: Justitia releases shadow strike up to 2 targets within 10 meters, causes Fire DMG equal to 800% of Spell Power, and summons a Mirage in the target's position to attack it. The mirage exists for 50 sec, up to 4 Mirages at the same time. The Mirage inherits Justitia's attributes by 100% of HP and 100% of Spell Power, and all of other attributes. The mirage count as summons, and can inherit parts of trigger effect. (Inherited effect: Thunderstrike, 8 Set of Gem (Wolverine, Hoarfrost Hoof), Rage Steal of Souleaters Front, Rank 6 of Sunstrider)

scaling.text: Fire DMG equal to 800% of Spell Power

skills.name: Steel Breaker
skills.description: When an enemy appears within 8 m of Apostle of Judgment, Apostle of Judgment quickly rushes toward it. After reaching the target, Apostle of Judgment gains a heavy-strike Normal Attack effect (Normal Attack DMG increased by 300%) and Attack Speed increased by 30%+per point of Spell Mastery*0.5% (never exceeding 60%); these effects last 2 sec. If Mirages exist, the Mirages also use the [Steel Breaker] skill.

skills.name: Tactical Evasion
skills.description: Justitia has a keen ability to sense danger, and will disappear from the battlefield for a short time when she is about to take fatal damage. After 1 sec, Justitia appears in a random position near the place where she disappeared, and has 100% of chance to summon 2 new Mirages.

skills.name: Prerogative of Judgement
skills.description: Justitia and her Mirages have a 25% of dodge chance, and All Damage Dealt increased by 15%.

skills.name: Lethal Ultimatum
skills.description: After every 3 normal attacks, Justitia can attack the enemy with her destructive techniques, causes Fire DMG equal to 300% of her Spell Power.

scaling.text: Fire DMG equal to 300% of Spell Power

skills.name: Cascade Tactics
skills.description: Apostle of Judgment and her mirages have precise coordinated combat ability When multiple summons are on the field, each one increases the DMG dealt by Apostle of Judgment and her mirages by 5%, up to 30%.

skills.name: Bully
skills.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with lower spell power or physical power by 12%

skills.name: Lethal Ambush
skills.description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with full health by 15%

skills.name: Shadowmeld
skills.description: When taking damage, there is a 10% chance to trigger Shadowmeld, immune to the damage, and immune to all damage for the next 0.2 sec. (Trigger interval 10 sec).
